featured_reviews.name: A.K
featured_reviews.review_text:
Pakeeza caterers was the one selected after tasting & observing the delicacies as well as the organisational skills in managing  wedding receptions from amongst a few caterers of repute (It would be unethical to name them).A gala wedding reception was conducted at The Grand Hamvi Gardens near Oshiwara on Tuesday the 23rd of Dec'25 attended by hundreds of Elite guests & I am extremely pleased to mention that each & every guest was left in awe 1st by the chic uniforms & secondly by the prompt services & humility of the attending catering staff.Attendees were offered tasty thirst quencher welcome drink before they could even sit on the seats.The freshly prepared hot & simmering starters namely Chicken Torento,Karachi roll,Tay fay seekh & Fish in kampao sauce were simply outstanding in taste as well as quality & quantity.Only a few braveheads could try the next serving of Chicken Dum Murg & Mutton Nihari with Garlic Naan & Lachha Paratha which melted in the mouth no sooner did one savor it.
The guests with their hearts satiated with such heavenly food were served jeera Rice with Dal Tadka just for a feel of authentic veg cuisine which too was highly appreciated by one & all.Lastly instead of the customary bottle of cold drink Fruit Champaigne was offered which too was ethereal.
Adding to the Ambience was the live counter of Fresh fruits , Truffle & Icecreams in multiple flavours.
I the groom's Father am extremely pleased with Yusufbhai who was on his toes the entire evening marshalling his group with great zeal to convert our event a memorable one for every one who attended & I can say for sure that he has fulfilled all obligations & commitments assured to us before us assigning this responsibility.
He hasn't simply created a customer from us but I dare say he has converted us into his P.R.O for ever.
At any point of time as & when if anyone were to inquire about catereing service providers with me & my relatives & friendsPakeeza won't be one of the names to be discussed Pakeeza Caterers will be the ONLY ONE to be
requested to organise on our behalf that's the goodwill they have created in our minds & hearts.
I wish them immense success & appreciation which they genuinely deserve in all ther forthcoming assignments

P.S :
Photos of the reception hasn't reached me as yet no sooner do they arrive I will definitely post them for all to get a firsthand view of the Ambience.

The kebabs were equally impressive, with the mutton kebabs being particularly tender and juicy. The cheesy kebabs were a nice surprise, with a delightful balance of creamy cheese and spicy meat.

Service: 5/5

The service from Meher Catering was top-notch. The ordering process was seamless, and the staff were friendly and responsive to our queries. The food was delivered promptly, and the packaging was secure and convenient.

Value for Money: 5/5

Considering the high quality of the food and the generous portion sizes, Meher Catering offers excellent value for money. The prices are reasonable, and the catering service is perfect for special occasions or large gatherings.

Verdict

Meher Catering is a must-try for anyone looking for delicious, authentic Indian cuisine. With its exceptional food quality, top-notch service, and excellent value for money, Meher Catering is sure to impress even the most discerning palates.

Price*: Reasonable (around ₹500-₹1,000 for a meal for 4-6 people)

Recommended for*: Special occasions, large gatherings, and anyone looking for authentic Indian cuisine.

Will I return?
Absolutely, to try more of Meher Catering's delicious dishes and experience their exceptional service once again.

featured_reviews.name: Akshay Bhattacharya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Important Notice to All Customers:
It’s a humble request to please avoid placing any orders from Lazeez Caterers, Goregaon (Mr. Haroon Khan – Owner) for any occasion.

I have been one of their regular customers for over 10 years, and it’s truly disappointing that I have to write this as a concerned and loyal consumer, but I don’t want anyone else to face the same experience.

We had ordered 1.5 kg Chicken Tikka Biryani and 24 Seekh Rolls for our family members on the occasion of Bhai Dooj. Unfortunately, the biryani contained mostly rice with very few chicken pieces and dry masala, even after specifically informing the caterer in advance that we wanted it flavorful and not dry. The seekh rolls were also extremely salty and unpalatable.

We returned 1 kg of biryani and the seekh rolls and shared our feedback, yet the owner showed no courtesy, offered no discount or replacement, and instead insisted on full payment including delivery charges, without taking any responsibility for the poor quality.

I was genuinely disappointed with the food quality, the service, and the arrogant attitude of the owner over the phone. Despite everything, I still paid the full amount of ₹2400 via GPay.

Kindly take note before placing any orders from this vendor. 🙏🏻

Overall pathetic service, unacceptable and really disappointed.
